in_sanskrit.name: दिप्तेन्दु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दिप्तः (Dipta) - Light, ईशानः (Ishana) - God, तेन् (ten) - possessed by, दुः (duh) - difficult, इति (iti) - thus. Thus, Diptendu means God, who is difficult to attain and is the source of divine light.

in_hindi.name: दिप्तेन्दु
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिप्तः (Dipta) - Light, ईशानः (Ishana) - God, तेन् (ten) - possessed by, दुः (duh) - difficult, इति (iti) - thus. Thus, Diptendu means God, who is difficult to attain and is the source of divine light.

in_tamil.name: டிப்டெண்டு
in_tamil.long_meaning: டிப் (Tip) - Light, டெண் (Ten) - possessed by, ந் (ndu) - new, உங்கள் (ungal) - our, இது (itu) - this. Thus, Diptendu in Tamil means 'our new light' or 'the light that is within us'.

in_telugu.name: దిప్పెన్టూ
in_telugu.long_meaning: దీప్ (Dipta) - Light, ఎణ్టూ (entu) - possessed by, దేశముదే (desamude) - God. Thus, Diptendu in Telugu means 'God who is the source of light'.

in_marathi.name: Diptendu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the deep or inner
in_marathi.long_meaning: Diptendu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Diptendu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dp' meaning deep and 'tam' meaning inner or enduring. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is often depicted as the preserver of the universe. Diptendu is a name for a boy that signifies a deep and enduring connection to the spiritual world and a strong sense of inner wisdom and understanding.
